narr: Clusters of thunderstorms developed during the late morning in northwest Alabama producing locally excessive rainfall. During the afternoon, new clusters of thunderstorms developed in northeast Alabama, producing hail up to one inch and gusty winds which knocked down at least one tree.
ev: Portions of County Road 462 reduced to one lane due to flood waters from Hurricane Creek. Depth of water unknown, but roadway is not closed or impassable at this time.
